Vintage Turkish Oushak Rug – 305 x 370 cm (10.0 x 12.1 ft)

Stock Code: 11103

A stunning 60+ year-old Turkish Oushak rug, handwoven from 100% hand-spun wool and featuring the timeless elegance that has made Oushak rugs beloved for generations. With its soft color palette, refined motifs, and authentic vintage character, this piece creates a warm and sophisticated focal point in any room.

Material & Design

100% hand-spun wool-on-wool
Handwoven by skilled Turkish artisans
Naturally dyed using traditional methods
Authentic Oushak motifs with classic Anatolian design elements
Ideal for living rooms, dining rooms, bedrooms, offices, and large interior spaces

Size

305 x 370 cm (10.0 x 12.1 ft)

Age

Approximately 60+ years old

Rug Story

Woven decades ago in Anatolia, this vintage Oushak rug reflects the rich weaving traditions of Turkish artisans. Each knot carries the legacy of generations of craftsmanship, while the elegant patterns and naturally aged beauty create a timeless piece that blends seamlessly with both traditional and contemporary interiors.

Condition

Professionally washed
Clean and ready for immediate use
Beautiful vintage condition with authentic age-related character

Delivery typically within 3–5 business days
Buyer is responsible for any customs duties or local taxes

Photography Note

All photos were taken under natural daylight without Photoshop.
Slight color variations may occur due to lighting and screen settings. Natural daylight provides the most accurate representation of the rug’s colors.
